stories.title: Bridging India's skills gap: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme faces low corporate participation
stories.summary: India's National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme faces low corporate participation. Many young graduates lack practical work experience, creating a significant skills gap. Low engagement from MSMEs and startups hinders the program's overall effectiveness. Improving NAPS accessibility and support can unlock economic potential for the nation. Companies must view apprentices as long-term talent investments, not just costs.

stories.title: SEMICON India 2026: Chip away into the whole ecosystem, policy should look beyond fab units
stories.summary: India's semiconductor policy must now focus on the entire ecosystem beyond fabrication units. The nation should strategically dominate select points along the global chip supply chain. Incentives should secure localisation for critical materials and equipment production. Government procurement and institutional testing capacity will support local vendors. Developing a skilled workforce through apprenticeships is essential for future growth.

stories.title: CBIC cuts paperwork in deferred customs duty scheme to boost MSME participation and ease cash flow
stories.summary: The CBIC is simplifying its deferred customs duty scheme for manufacturers. Paperwork has been reduced from ten documents down to just three. Outreach programs will now handhold MSMEs to encourage scheme adoption. This initiative aims to ease cash flow and working capital for businesses. The scheme allows duty payments in monthly installments until March 2028.
